{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = data[(data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Convert revenue
loyal_completed['revenue_float'] = loyal_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = loyal_completed['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

# Display the QA order(s)
qa_orders = loyal_completed[qa_mask]
print("QA orders found in LOYAL completed:")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'revenue', 'revenue_float']])

# Remove QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[~qa_mask]

# Recompute mean
mean_revenue_clean = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_float'].mean()

# Output
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders (before cleaning): {len(loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Number of QA orders in that group: {qa_count}")
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders (after cleaning): {len(loyal_completed_clean)}")
print(f"Clean mean revenue: {mean_revenue_clean}")"}
